text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending the installation of speed bumps in the first east-west public lane north of Dundas Street West, between Manning Avenue and Euclid Avenue.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of speed bumps in first east-west public lane north of Dundas Street West, between Manning Avenue and Euclid Avenue, at the locations shown on Drawing 421G-3497, attached to the report (August 30, 2019) from the Acting Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services.
